description: Plan v7 sections 4.6 and 8.3: 'Generated depth and cumulative expansion budgets reset for each locale attempt', and DefaultStrings.java:1203 constructs a new GeneratedExpansionBudget inside every per-candidate getInternal call. With the budget at 6, fr spends 7 and fails while en spends exactly 6; an implementation that shared one budget across the fallback walk would have nothing left for en. en and fr are different primary languages, so tiebreakers are absent.
